enterprise.idea: I want to build software for finance teams at multinational retailers to reconcile store cash deposits. They currently compare bank statements and till exports in spreadsheets, which delays month-end reporting. I have no product or customers yet.
enterprise.name: Deposit Ledger

landing_page.headline: Reconcile your store cash deposits
landing_page.hero: Help shape deposit reconciliation for retail finance teams.
steps: Upload bank statements and till exports.

answers.customer: Finance teams at multinational retailers who reconcile store cash deposits.
answers.offer: Software that reconciles store cash deposits for retail finance teams.
answers.workflow: You upload bank statements and till exports, match deposits, and review unmatched amounts.
answers.pricing_hypothesis: I would test a monthly subscription with retail finance teams before setting a price.
answers.first_user_path: I would ask retail finance teams for interviews through industry associations. I have not contacted anyone yet.
answers.desired_outcome: A finance team completes a deposit reconciliation with fewer unmatched records.
answers.constraints: The first version must not move money or expose store financial records.
answers.problem: Comparing bank statements and till exports in spreadsheets delays month-end reporting.
answers.requirements: You must be able to review and correct every suggested deposit match.
answers.Q1: I have no customers, payments or interviews yet. I would first interview retail finance teams about deposit reconciliation.
answers.Q2: Retail finance teams compare bank statements and till exports in spreadsheets today.
answers.Q3: Finance directors at multinational retailers manage deposit reconciliation and month-end reporting.

enterprise.people: Find finance directors at multinational retailers who reconcile store cash deposits.
enterprise.experiment: Design a one-week experiment to test whether these finance teams will pay for deposit reconciliation. Do not send messages or publish anything.

demo.idea: I want to build software for finance teams at retailers to reconcile store deposits. No customers yet.
demo.name: Deposit Ledger
demo.experiment: Design a one-week paid pilot experiment.

health_tech.idea: I want to build software for outpatient cardiology clinics to follow up with patients after hospital discharge. Nurses currently track callback lists in spreadsheets and miss patients who need timely appointments. I have no product or customers yet.
health_tech.name: Followup Desk

landing_page.headline: Keep discharge follow-up in view
landing_page.hero: Help shape callback coordination for outpatient cardiology clinics.
steps: Track appointments that still need follow-up.

answers.customer: Nurse managers at outpatient cardiology clinics who coordinate discharge follow-up.
answers.offer: Software that organizes callback lists and follow-up appointments for outpatient cardiology clinics.
answers.workflow: You import an authorized callback list, record contact attempts, and track appointments that still need follow-up.
answers.pricing_hypothesis: I would test a monthly clinic subscription after interviewing nurse managers.
answers.first_user_path: I would request interviews with clinic nurse managers through professional associations. I have not contacted anyone yet.
answers.desired_outcome: A nurse manager can identify every callback that still needs follow-up.
answers.constraints: The first version must not make medical decisions or collect patient records without authorization.
answers.problem: Spreadsheet callback lists make it difficult to track patients who need timely appointments.
answers.requirements: You must be able to correct the callback status and limit access to authorized clinic staff.
answers.Q1: I have no customers, payments or interviews yet. I would first interview nurse managers about follow-up coordination.
answers.Q2: Clinic nurses currently track callback lists and appointment follow-up in spreadsheets.
answers.Q3: Nurse managers at outpatient cardiology clinics coordinate discharge follow-up and review outstanding callbacks.

health_tech.people: Find nurse managers at outpatient cardiology clinics who coordinate follow-up after hospital discharge.
health_tech.experiment: Design a one-week experiment to test whether these clinics will pay for discharge follow-up coordination. Do not send messages or publish anything.

demo.name: Followup Desk
demo.experiment: Design a one-week paid coordination experiment.
